content:
Sometimes I want to read a specific topic in a specific channel which is too old for message search history.
E.g. I start typing a topic name, and see something relevant in the suggestions box which might already answer my question. ¶ E.g., I read a thread a week ago while scrolling deep through the topics list and some info in there is suddenly relevant to me. I type a few letters of the topic name and it completes to the one I want to view.

Currently my choices are scrolling through the topics list for an unknown amount of time (which is human error prone), or bumping.
At the risk of #xy / "a faster horse", it would be nice to e.g. filter the topics list by name.
Maybe you're looking for something like the "go to conversation" button we have in the web app?
What, where is this button? Could you send an uncropped screenshot with an arrow?

Thanks!
This button is only for exact names AFAIK, but I think OP is asking for partial names / fuzzy match:

Chris C said:

I type a few letters of the topic name and it completes to the one I want to view
Right, you accept the completion, and then navigate to the topic.
